O217xQsEUgI.title: Navigating High Resistance Liquidity Run Conditions
O217xQsEUgI.summary: This video demonstrates live intraday trade execution and management using Inversion Fair Value Gaps and candle body behavior relative to wick Consequent Encroachment (CE). ICT emphasizes anticipating price behavior on the hard right edge, targeting the NY Midnight Opening Price, and applying defensive partial stops during high-resistance conditions to manage risk and psychology.

dmHSwlmS9iY.title: The Week In The Life Cycle Of Price
dmHSwlmS9iY.summary: This lecture details ICT's weekly price cycle framework for determining market bias, identifying the draw on liquidity, and executing Friday TGIF retracement setups. By starting analysis on continuous futures contracts to establish key weekly and monthly levels, traders can determine order flow direction and utilize macro time windows (9:50–10:10 AM) alongside Inversion FVGs and Rejection Blocks to trade expected 20–30% weekly range retracements.
dmHSwlmS9iY.modelName: TGIF Retracement Model / ICT Silver Bullet

inversion_fair_value_gap_entry_and_scale.name: Inversion Fair Value Gap Entry and Scale-In
rules: Identify an Inversion Fair Value Gap (IFVG) acting as support in an anticipated bullish run.
Enter initial position inside or at the low/high threshold of the IFVG.
Add additional contracts (scale-in) when price retests the top or deep end of the IFVG and respects it.
Trail stop loss to the low of the IFVG minus 1-2 ticks once the retest is qualified.

wick_consequent_encroachment_candle_body.name: Wick Consequent Encroachment & Candle Body Defense
rules: Mark the 50% midpoint (Consequent Encroachment / CE) of prominent wicks in the direction of the trade.
Candle wicks are allowed to pierce below/above CE, but candle bodies must NOT close past the CE level.
A close above the candle open price or above the CE of a key wick confirms immediate willingness to continue higher.
If a candle closes below CE of a key defensive wick, expect deeper retracements or high-resistance conditions.

defensive_retracement_partialing_stop_lo.name: Defensive Retracement Partialing & Stop-Loss Scaling
rules: In high-resistance or disorganized market run conditions, take initial partial profits at immediate targets like NY Midnight Open.
If price hesitates and threatens to retrace below a minor short-term low, place a defensive stop order for a partial position above full stop loss.
Executing a partial stop-out on a pullback reduces net position exposure, locks in gains, and removes psychological strain.
Allow the remaining partial contracts to ride with stop anchored under validated structural lows.

tgif_weekly_range_retracement_model.name: TGIF Weekly Range Retracement Model
rules: On Friday, after the market has completed its weekly expansion toward HTF liquidity targets, expect a TGIF retracement back into the weekly range.
Target a retracement depth of 20% to 30% (ideally ~25%) of the total weekly range established up to Friday morning.
Confluence for the 20%-30% retracement target often aligns with key reference levels such as the previous week's high or previous month's high.
The Friday high typically forms during the morning session between 9:30 AM and 10:10 AM Eastern Time.

guarded_liquidity_identification.name: Guarded Liquidity Identification
rules: Relative equal highs or buy-side liquidity pools are not always swept; smart money may guard them during distribution phases.
If price approaches relative equal highs during key macro windows (e.g., 9:50 AM – 10:10 AM) and respects a rejection block rather than breaking out, the buyside is guarded.
Order flow confirmation occurs when candle bodies refuse to close above key rejection levels or upper halves of premium wicks.

continuous_contract_htf_bias_draw_on_liq.name: Continuous Contract HTF Bias & Draw on Liquidity
rules: Always begin weekly and monthly bias analysis on a Continuous Futures Contract to avoid rollover gaps and distorted key levels.
Map previous month's high/low and previous week's high/low across continuous data and blend with front-month contract data.
Determine the Draw on Liquidity by evaluating path of least resistance from the weekly open relative to nearest HTF liquidity pools in the direction of dominant order flow.
